title: Add curation feedback hook and changelog fragmenter
author: Priya Rao
release_notes: Introduce a manual curation feedback hook (web + API), a changelog fragmenter that converts curator annotations into compact changelog snippets, and a lightweight profile-adjuster that suggests metadata deltas from feedback. Backward-compatible; adds a v2 optional field to model metadata. Includes a small UI for curators and a CLI flag to export fragments.
description:
Context: We get a lot of human-sourced annotations during model onboard and curation reviews (quality notes, behavior flags, performance hints). Today these live in spreadsheets or ad-hoc Linear comments and are not systematically surfaced into the model registry changelog or the performance profile pipeline. This PR wires a lightweight feedback path that: 1) accepts signed curator annotations (web UI + POST API), 2) runs a short mapping pipeline that synthesizes 'changelog fragments' (concise, provenance-tagged statements) and suggested profile deltas (e.g. adjust latency expectation, highlight tokenization quirks), and 3) persists fragments and deltas in the model registry so release automation can include curator-sourced notes in release drafts.

Goals: make curator feedback first-class, speed up release note drafting, and provide auditability and provenance for human edits.

What I changed (high level):
- New "curation_queue" DB table (append-only) + lightweight provenance token to track annotator and Linear link.
- API: POST /v2/models/{model_id}/curation_annotations accepts schema {author, linear_ref, category, text, severity, sample_ref, signed_at}. Validation + rate-limit.
- Mapping pipeline: annotator-mapper service (stateless) with rules that emit changelog fragments and optional profile deltas (json-patches for model profiles).
- UI: small curator panel in registry UI (curation tab) to submit, preview fragment, and mark for release inclusion.
- CLI: registry-cli export-fragments --since=DATE to dump fragments for release engineers.
- Database migration and a short backward-compatible metadata v2 addition (optional fields: last_curator_note_id, curator_signatures).
- Tests: unit tests for mapper rules, e2e for API + UI happy path, small contract tests for persistence.
- Docs: new curator workflow doc and changelog-fragmenter design note.

Rollout plan: roll out mapper as opt-in; curator UI flag behind feature-flag; initial rollout to internal curation team only.

Migration: DB migration is append-only and adds nullable columns. No destructive change.

To reviewers: please focus on the mapper rules, API auth/ratelimiting choices, and the minimal profile-delta semantics (we allow only non-destructive suggestions; actual profile mutation is manual, except for an optional admin-apply CLI).

Checklist:
- [x] API + validation
- [x] DB migration (append-only)
- [x] Mapper service + sensible defaults
- [x] Curator UI + accessibility checks
- [x] CLI export + docs
- [x] Unit and integration tests
- [x] Security review for signed annotations

Open questions / tradeoffs:
- We currently map severity -> suggested profile delta only for a small set of keys (latency_bucket, sample_failure_rate). Do we expand mapping now or wait for more curator examples? Suggest iterative expansion.
- Signature format: we use an HMAC token tied to user id for now; future HSM/KMS signing could be added.
- Retention: fragments are persisted indefinitely but export tooling supports filtering.

Implementation notes:
- Mapper uses a rule-table (yaml) in repo/curation/rules/*.yaml for easy authoring by PMs/curators.
- The fragment format is compact to make release messages concise: {type, summary, provenance_ref}.
- Example fragment: "Performance: intermittent tokenization mismatch on emails — sample #A23 — curator @samira/LINEAR-402".

Security/permissions: only curator role can POST; API rejects unsigned entries; entries go into a pending state for editors.

CI: run-unit-tests, ui-e2e (flaky slow test re-run 1), lint. All green on this branch.

Monitoring: emitter metric registry.curation.submissions and mapper.fragment_count added to dashboard.

Degradation plan: if mapper misbehaves, disable mapping via map.enabled=false and curator UI still persists raw annotations for manual processing.

Priya Rao: Added attachment support and client-side 2000 char soft-limit with tooltip. Server enforces 8000 hard limit.

Priya Rao: Implemented token age check and audit log write on approvals. Added unit tests for token expiry.
